project_type: WECARE.DIGITAL — WhatsApp + Wix headless conversational commerce on AWS Amplify Gen2; Next.js 16 static-export storefront (src/) + Python 3.12 Lambda backend (amplify/functions/)
language: Python 3.12 (Lambda handlers), TypeScript/React (Next.js static export frontend)
build_system: Amplify Gen2 (amplify/backend.ts); npm for frontend (next build, output: export). Python Lambdas are plain modules; shared code under amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils imported via conftest sys.path shim.
test_framework: pytest (conftest.py REQUIRES Python >=3.12 or raises UsageError) for Python; vitest for TS; tsc --noEmit for typecheck. New payment tests must drive the real handler against an in-memory DynamoDB fake, not static mocks.
build_command: npm run build (static export, ~1407 sitemap URLs; may intermittently fail on transient upstream 429 during /post/[slug] blog export — re-run to confirm exit 0; do NOT weaken the fail-hard build safety)
test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q    (then: npx tsc --noEmit ; npx vitest run)
verification_instructions: Use the repo .venv built from /usr/bin/python3.12 (NEVER system python3=3.9, conftest will reject it). Known-good exact-tree gates that MUST stay green: pytest -q => 5717 passed, 1 skipped; npx tsc --noEmit => exit 0; npx vitest run => 650 passed across 45 files; npm run build => exit 0. New tests must exercise real code paths.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in from build/test. _routes.json is a dated inventory snapshot, NOT runtime config (no code reads it). Build produces a static export under out/ (gitignored).
setup_instructions: python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt (requirements-dev.txt now resolves: multidict==6.9.1 with aiohttp==3.14.3). npm ci (~789 pkgs; EBADENGINE node>=24 warning is non-fatal on node v22).
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET (pip/npm reachable). AWS has NO credentials (aws sts get-caller-identity fails; no ~/.aws, no wecare-prod profile) — ALL live AWS operations are BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT and must be delivered as source + IaC + runbook, never executed or faked. A live AWS key was pasted in chat earlier: must NOT be used, stored, or echoed. Never read/print any secret value; never call secretsmanager get-secret-value; use {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}} references only. Any Cognito change must go through scripts/cognito_pool_safe_update.py (UpdateUserPool is a full replace with a recorded trigger-deletion incident). WAF/Security Hub are out of scope.
contribution_requirements: Steering git-workflow.md: SINGLE BRANCH 'stack'. Commit directly to stack; NO feature/fix branches; do NOT push; do NOT open a PR (orchestrator pushes). Explicit-path staging only (never git add -A/.); no force, no reset, no history rewrite, never reset to a historical SHA. If origin/stack advances, MERGE (no rebase/force) and re-run gates on the merged tree.
key_patterns: The webhook body is NEVER money authority: every financial decision is re-derived from an authoritative provider readback (lambda_utils/integrations/razorpay_verify) or a stored intent; every money primitive is a conditional DynamoDB write (order_keys._claim_row / claim_order_for_payment / reserve_topup_intent / claim_topup_credit / record_capture_quarantine). order_creation.py defines typed outcomes with two curated sets: NO_ORDER_OUTCOMES (money did not move) vs PAID_BUT_BLOCKED_OUTCOMES={AMOUNT_MISMATCH,CURRENCY_MISMATCH,CUSTOMER_MISMATCH,IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE,PROVIDER_PAYMENT_CONFLICT}. Money arithmetic is integer paise via ecommerce/money.py (floats/fractional paise forbidden). Logs emit type-only / correlation ids, never event bodies or secrets.
relevant_files: amplify/functions/ecommerce/checkout/handler.py (in-chat WIX_HEADLESS initiator with _send_order_details — the in-WhatsApp payment flow to retire from active path; initiation gate CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED default off)
